messages:
Marco P: Quick ping — need final alignment on SI enablement gates before next cloud marketplace launch. High level: training tracks, lab access gating, & certification levels.
Elaine S: +1. Can we lock the Minimum Viable Gate (MVG) for lab access? We keep getting SIs trying to book GPUs before they finish the sandbox tasks.
Devon L: Proposed MVG: complete the sandbox guide + one architect walkthrough call. Then grant staging labs for 48h. Thoughts?
Sam R: Sounds good. For hardware partners (Nimble) we also need a signed NDAs and acceptance of hardware usage guidelines before hands-on access. @Nimble any red flags?
Nimble (partner): No red flags on our side. We'll need a list of approved images and max vram per session. Can you share the lab ops doc?
Marco P: Link: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/si-labs-ops (internal). Also adding the small checklist we discussed:
```
- complete sandbox walkthrough
- submit SI intake form
- sign partner terms
- attend 1x live architecture review
- pass lab verification task (basic inference run)
```
Rachel T: For cert paths, rather than Bronze/Silver/Gold, propose Practitioner / Integrator / Architect. Each has a prompt-set and a gated eval. Passing Integrator grants production deployment playbook access.
Elaine S: Love the three-tier naming. Add periodic recert every 12 months for Architect.
Sam R: We should also add a "joint announcement" clause: only after Integrator or Architect passes and we get customer permission. This avoids premature co-marketing.
Devon L: Timeline check: can training content + lab gating be ready for beta SIs by 4 weeks from now? My risks: test infra quota and automation for granting lab access.
Marco P: 4 weeks is tight but doable if we automate intake -> intake form webhook -> infra job. @Onboarding Bot can we scope automation tasks?
Onboarding Bot: I can create a Zap/Workflow to 1) validate intake form, 2) provision staging creds for 48h, 3) ping lab-ops for hardware allocation. Need API keys from infra team.
Rachel T: I'll own the eval test design. Will post sample prompt sets by EOD Friday.
Elaine S: I'll draft a short SLA for lab access (uptime/VRAM limits). Also want an audit log requirement for hardware usage.
Sam R: Ok next steps: Rachel posts prompts, Marco wires intake webhook, Elaine drafts SLA, Nimble provides approved images list. Weekly sync Friday 10am PT? :calendar: 
Marco P: Perfect — I'll send calendar invite and update the playbook doc. Thanks everyone :rocket:
